description: List the domains this account owns, with each domain's routing mode (`catchall` accepts every local part, `rules` accepts only the listed ones), its bound local parts, whether its receive worker is deployed and ready, and its outbound capability (`canSend`, `sendingConfigured`, `sendingState`). A domain with `sendingConfigured: false` can receive mail but has no outbound provider yet — sending from it is refused until sending is set up in the dashboard. Use a domain's `id` for `list_addresses` and `create_address`.
name: list_domains
